steady-30.why: The typical case: half an hour every day.

steady-45.why: What 15 more minutes a day buys.

busy-20.why: Real life: 20 minutes, Saturdays off, a missed day about one in six.

crammer.why: Ten minutes a day, then 90 in the last week.

steady-30-half-scope.why: A midterm on the first six sections only.

steady-30-no-date.why: The same student without telling the app the exam date.

steady-30-old-prompt.why: The course shape the older prompt produced.

steady-30-harsh.why: Sensitivity: a student who forgets much faster. Conclusions should survive this.

steady-30-quota.why: Policy experiment: new material first, spread over the days left.

steady-30-cutoff.why: Lectures run up to the exam; the last week of them is not on it.

steady-30-cutoff-no-date.why: As steady-30-cutoff, without telling the app the exam date.

steady-45-cutoff-no-date.why: As steady-45-cutoff, without the exam date.

steady-45-cutoff-harsh.why: Sensitivity for the exam-date finding: steady-45-cutoff, harsh forgetting.

steady-45-cutoff-harsh-no-date.why: As steady-45-cutoff-harsh, without the exam date.

steady-30-follow-app.why: Before the Today plan: Review until nothing is due, then Learn (the old course page).

steady-30-half-scope-told.why: As steady-30-half-scope, and the student tells the app which sections.

steady-30-cutoff-scope.why: As steady-30-cutoff, and the app knows which sections are on the exam.

steady-45-cutoff-scope.why: As steady-45-cutoff, with the exam sections known.

late-start.why: Nothing until four days out, then two hours a day.

crammer-split.why: crammer, the last three days in three sittings set by hand.

late-start-split.why: late-start, the last three days in three sittings set by hand.

steady-30-questions-first.why: steady-30, with Learn set to questions first.

steady-45-questions-first.why: steady-45, with Learn set to questions first.

busy-20-questions-first.why: busy-20, with Learn set to questions first.

crammer-questions-first.why: crammer, with Learn set to questions first.

steady-30-harsh-questions-first.why: steady-30-harsh, with Learn set to questions first.

steady-45-harsh-questions-first.why: steady-45-harsh, with Learn set to questions first.

steady-30-evening.why: steady-30, then Today again 4 hours later for the 5-minute catch-up.

steady-30-retry.why: steady-30, retrying the misses at once, then the catch-up 4 hours later.

crammer-retry.why: crammer, retrying the misses at once, then the catch-up.
